data.description: The Community Comprises a Mix of Residential Towers, Hotels, and Commercial Buildings.

data.answer: Barsha Heights offers a vibrant lifestyle with plenty of entertainment options. There are parks, sports facilities, and entertainment venues that cater to various interests. Despite its bustling nature, Barsha Heights also maintains a sense of community, with many events and activities organized for residents.

Barsha Heights offers a diverse range of real estate options. The residential properties here are known for their quality and modern amenities. Whether you're looking to rent or buy, you'll find a range of options that cater to different budgets and preferences.

Tecom Barsha Heights is home to several popular buildings that define its skyline and offer a range of residential and commercial spaces. Notable buildings include the First Central Hotel Suites, a prominent hotel known for its luxurious accommodations and amenities. 

The Onyx is a mixed-use development featuring residential, office, and retail spaces with modern architecture. Similarly, Auris Metro Central Hotel Apartments offer stylish serviced apartments ideal for short and long-term stays. The neighborhood also boasts the sophisticated TECOM Tower and the vibrant Al Shafar Tower, both housing numerous businesses and contributing to the area’s reputation as a bustling commercial hub. Icon Tower Barsha Heights is a commercial building with 11 floors dedicated to office units.

Buying a Property in Barsha Heights Dubai

Are you searching for properties for sale in Dubai? Investors and home buyers can find studio apartments in Tecom Barsha Heights for AED 370k, while 1-bedroom apartments are available for AED 499.4k. The minimum price for 2-bedroom apartments is AED 1.15M, and 3-bedroom units are available for AED 1.65M.

Rental Properties in Barsha Heights Dubai

For those looking to rent property in Dubai near Dubai Internet City or Media City, The Greens is an ideal option. Cozy studios and 1-bedroom apartments start at AED 51.9k and AED 65k, respectively. Families can choose from 2 or 3-bedroom apartments, with 2-bedroom units starting at AED 81.8k annually and 3-bedroom apartments at AED 133k.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Barsha Heights?

data.answer:
Living in Barsha Heights offers a vibrant urban lifestyle with a mix of residential and commercial spaces. The area is bustling with activity, providing a wide range of amenities and services, making it an attractive choice for professionals, families, and expatriates. 

Residents enjoy a diverse selection of restaurants, cafes, and retail shops, along with the convenience of nearby educational institutions and healthcare facilities. The community atmosphere is enhanced by well-maintained parks and recreational areas, promoting a balanced and enjoyable lifestyle.

Public Transportation in Barsha Heights

Barsha Heights is well-connected by public transportation, making commuting easy and convenient for residents. The Dubai Internet City Metro Station on the Red Line is the nearest Barsha Heights metro station, providing quick access to other parts of the city.

Moreover, the area is serviced by several bus routes, ensuring that all parts of Barsha Heights are accessible by public transit. The availability of taxis and ride-sharing services further enhances the ease of transportation within the community.

Supermarkets in Barsha Heights

Residents of Barsha Heights have access to several supermarkets that cater to their daily needs. Popular options include Carrefour Market, which offers a wide range of groceries and household items, and Geant Express, known for its fresh produce and quality products. Smaller convenience stores are also scattered throughout the area, providing quick and easy shopping options for residents. These supermarkets ensure that all essentials are within easy reach, contributing to the overall convenience of living in Barsha Heights.

Shopping Malls in and Near Barsha Heights Area

Barsha Heights residents have easy access to several shopping malls that offer a variety of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Mall of the Emirates, one of Dubai's largest shopping destinations, is just a 10-minute drive away. This mall features numerous international brands, a cinema, and the famous indoor ski resort, Ski Dubai. 

The Greens Souk, a smaller shopping center, is only a 5-minute drive and provides convenient access to supermarkets, cafes, and essential services. For more high-end shopping, Dubai Marina Mall is a 15-minute drive away, offering a scenic shopping experience along the waterfront.

Barsha Heights Schools and Nurseries

Barsha Heights is an ideal location for families due to its proximity to several reputable schools and nurseries. American School of Dubai is just a 10-minute drive, offering an American curriculum and state-of-the-art facilities. GEMS Dubai American Academy, located about 15 minutes away, provides a comprehensive education from kindergarten through high school. For younger children, Jumeirah International Nurseries is a popular choice, situated just 5 minutes away, offering a nurturing environment for early childhood education.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Barsha Heights

Barsha Heights is a culturally diverse area, with several places of worship catering to different faiths. Al Salam Mosque, located within Barsha Heights, is a 5-minute drive and serves the Muslim community with regular prayers and religious events. St. Mary’s Catholic Church is about a 20-minute drive away in Oud Metha, providing a spiritual hub for the Christian community. For Hindu residents, the Shiva and Krishna Mandir in Bur Dubai is approximately a 25-minute drive, offering a place for worship and cultural gatherings.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Barsha Heights

Residents of Barsha Heights have access to excellent healthcare facilities within a short driving distance. Saudi German Hospital, one of the top medical facilities in Dubai, is just a 10-minute drive away, offering a wide range of specialized medical services. Mediclinic Al Barsha is another nearby option, about 10 minutes away, known for its comprehensive outpatient care and specialist services. For daily health needs, Life Pharmacy in Barsha Heights provides convenient access to medications and health products, ensuring residents have their pharmaceutical needs met within a few minutes' walk.

Barsha Heights Location & Nearby Areas

Barsha Heights, strategically situated in the heart of Dubai, offers residents and visitors convenient access to various key areas in the city. It is bordered by Sheikh Zayed Road and Hessa Street, providing quick connectivity to major business districts like Dubai Internet City, Dubai Media City, and Knowledge Village. The community is just a 10-minute drive from the iconic Palm Jumeirah and a 15-minute drive from Downtown Dubai, making it an ideal location for both work and leisure.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Barsha Heights

data.answer:
Barsha Heights is a vibrant community with plenty of activities and attractions to keep residents and visitors entertained. You can enjoy a leisurely stroll in the well-maintained parks and communal areas, or take advantage of the numerous fitness centers and sports facilities available. The neighborhood also hosts various events and social gatherings, fostering a strong sense of community. For those interested in culture, nearby theaters and galleries offer a rich array of artistic experiences.

Restaurants in Barsha Heights

The dining scene in TECOM Barsha Heights Dubai is diverse, offering a variety of cuisines to suit all tastes. From casual cafes to fine dining establishments, there's something for everyone. Popular spots include Nando's, known for its peri-peri chicken, and Toshi, which offers a fusion of Asian cuisines.

Barsha Heights restaurants cater to different culinary preferences. Prego's is a favorite for Italian cuisine, while UCCI Sushi offers an authentic Japanese dining experience. Ostro, with its Mediterranean-inspired menu, is another popular choice among residents.

For those looking to unwind, there are several bars in Barsha Heights offering a lively nightlife scene. Lucky Voice is a popular karaoke bar, perfect for a fun night out with friends. Nelson’s offers a traditional pub atmosphere with a wide selection of drinks and hearty meals. The Belgian Cafe Barsha Heights is a standout venue, known for its extensive selection of Belgian beers and traditional Belgian dishes.

Beaches Near Barsha Heights

Barsha Heights is conveniently located close to some of Dubai's most popular beaches. Jumeirah Beach, known for its pristine sands and crystal-clear waters, is just a 15-minute drive away. Here, visitors can enjoy various water sports, beachside cafes, and stunning views of the Burj Al Arab. Kite Beach is another nearby option, approximately 20 minutes away, offering a lively atmosphere with food trucks, beach volleyball, and designated areas for kitesurfing.

Hotels in Barsha Heights

Barsha Heights boasts a variety of hotels catering to different preferences and budgets. The Media Rotana Barsha Heights is a prominent five-star hotel known for its luxurious accommodations and excellent service. 

It features multiple dining options, including international cuisine, a fitness center, and a rooftop pool with stunning city views. Millennium Place Barsha Heights Hotel, Signature 1 Hotel, Barsha Heights, and Ramada by Wyndham Dubai Barsha Heights are some of the other hotels in the area.

There is also TRYP by Wyndham Dubai, which offers modern amenities and a trendy atmosphere, and First Central Hotel Suites, known for its spacious rooms and convenient location.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Barsha Heights Dubai

Barsha Heights' central location provides easy access to several attractions and landmarks. Dubai Marina is just a 10-minute drive away, offering a picturesque waterfront promenade, dining, and shopping options. The Mall of the Emirates, with its vast array of retail stores and entertainment options like Ski Dubai, is also nearby, just a 10-minute drive. Additionally, the Palm Jumeirah, one of Dubai's most iconic landmarks, is approximately 15 minutes away, providing a luxurious retreat with its upscale hotels and beachfront clubs.

Outdoor Activities, Salons, and Gyms

Barsha Heights offers a range of outdoor activities, from leisurely park walks to more intense fitness routines. The Greens and Views Park is a nearby green space perfect for jogging, picnics, and family outings. For personal care and grooming, The Dollhouse Salon and Tips and Toes offer high-quality beauty treatments.

Fitness enthusiasts will find several gyms in Barsha Heights to maintain their workout routines. Fitness First is a popular choice, offering state-of-the-art equipment, personal training services, and group exercise classes. Snap Fitness is another excellent option, known for its 24/7 access and supportive community atmosphere.

nodes.title: The Chedi Private Residences
nodes.about:
Set along the prestigious Sheikh Zayed Road, The Chedi Private Residences by Al Seeb Development is a super luxury project with 2 to 5-bedroom villas and 6 and 8-bedroom mansions. Designed by Studio Bruno Guélaff, this 52-story architectural marvel offers fully equipped, branded, and serviced residences, ensuring an effortless blend of luxury and convenience. The off-plan development enjoys a prime location, making it a coveted address for both investors and homeowners seeking exclusivity in the city's dynamic landscape.

Beyond its striking design,  The Chedi Private Residences at Sheikh Zayed Road offers a world-class lifestyle across three distinct amenity levels—Ground Social, Resort Social, and Sky Social. Residents can indulge in a 60-meter lagoon-inspired pool, an adults-only infinity pool, exclusive Omakase dining, private cabanas, a wellness terrace, a state-of-the-art fitness center, a cinema, and a cigar lounge. Complemented by Chedi Navigator concierge services, valet parking, and round-the-clock security, this freehold residential landmark sets a new standard for luxury, privacy, and exclusivity in Dubai’s thriving real estate landscape.
